# Sololearn

> > Sololearn is an interactive coding education platform offering courses in Python, Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C++, C#, Swift, Kotlin, and 15+ programming languages with an integrated code playground.

Sololearn provides beginner-friendly to advanced programming courses with hands-on practice through their multi-language online compiler and code editor. The platform combines structured learning paths with an interactive web-based IDE for immediate code execution and experimentation.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Java
- JavaScript
- HTML
- CSS
- C++
- C#
- Swift
- Kotlin
- web-development
- code-playground
- online-compiler
- beginner-programming

- multi-language-support

## Platform Overview

- [Sololearn: Learn to Code](https://www.sololearn.com): Homepage for Sololearn's interactive coding education platform
- [Online Code Editors, Compilers & Playground | Sololearn](https://www.sololearn.com/compiler-playground): Multi-language code playground supporting Python, Java, HTML, CSS and 15+ more

## Programming Courses

- [Introduction to Java | Learn with Sololearn](https://www.sololearn.com/learn/courses/java-introduction): Java fundamentals course covering variables, conditionals, loops & arrays
- [Tech for Everyone | Learn with Sololearn](https://www.sololearn.com/learn/courses/tech-for-everyone): Beginner course covering programming basics, web dev, and Python intro

## Language Learning Paths

- [Learn HTML | Discover our Courses - Sololearn](https://www.sololearn.com/learn/languages/html): HTML course catalog for learning web development fundamentals
